title: Two-frequency localization
plain: Use a potential that is the sum of two cosines with frequencies √2 and √3, and take strong coupling. Prove electrons localize for these specific frequencies, not just for almost every frequency pair.
math: Let $(H_\theta\psi)(n)=\psi(n+1)+\psi(n-1)+10\big(\cos2\pi(n\sqrt2+\theta_1)+\cos2\pi(n\sqrt3+\theta_2)\big)\psi(n)$. Prove that for Lebesgue-a.e. $\theta\in\mathbb T^2$, $H_\theta$ has pure point spectrum with exponentially decaying eigenfunctions.
